findings.title: Attestation source commit did not contain the attested release
findings.resolution: scripts/verify-self-attestation.sh now compares manifest artifact paths and digests against source_commit. In the current dirty working tree, known missing or mismatched source artifacts are assessed negative evidence: source_commit_artifacts_verified is false, source_commit_status is mismatch, locally_attested is false, and trusted_contract_release remains false.

findings.title: Verifier ignored trusted identity policy and did not fail broken positive proofs
findings.resolution: The verifier derives the local private-equivalent signer from trusted_identity_policy_ref plus the public key fingerprint, checks the DSSE predicate policy ref and profile, validates case shape with schema/self-attestation-case.schema.json, asserts positive structural proof states, and includes a wrong-policy negative fixture.

findings.title: Local release artifact contradicted Block 03 trust state
findings.resolution: examples/contract-foundation/contract-release-verification.example.json now records trusted_contract_release false for the local-dev artifact, and contract-release-verification.schema.json rejects trusted true when transparency-log status is not an assessed accepted value.

findings.title: Self-trace recorded stale verified hashes
findings.resolution: Stale scripts/validate-contracts.sh digests were refreshed, and scripts/verify-artifact-hashes.sh now recomputes local artifact hashes for JSON examples that claim verified_hash or local-file payload_digest.

findings.title: Metric schema permitted assessed samples without evidence
findings.resolution: schema/metric-stream.schema.json now requires minItems: 1 for evidence_refs unless the sample is not_assessed, and examples/contract-foundation/negative-assessed-metric-without-evidence.json is an expect-fail fixture.

findings.title: Trace contract accepted native policy verdict fields
findings.resolution: schema/trace.schema.json now rejects prohibited native policy field names through propertyNames while preserving non-policy extension fields. examples/contract-foundation/negative-native-policy-trace.json is an expect-fail fixture. Legacy gate/evidence examples now mark pass/fail status as external.

findings.title: Validator migration was contradicted by current-facing resolution notes
findings.resolution: socratic-resolution-notes.md and 01-contract-foundation-socratic.md now mark ajv-cli@5.0.0 as superseded by exact local ajv@8.20.0 through scripts/validate-json-schema.mjs.

residual_not_assessed: source_commit_artifacts_verified is assessed false in the shared dirty worktree because the immutable source_commit does not contain the current manifest artifact set; a future clean source-bound release can assess it true after committing manifest subject artifacts and running the source-bound finalization guard
externally_attested remains not_assessed until Sigstore/Rekor or accepted customer PKI evidence is committed
production_release_verified remains not_assessed until external attestation and release policy checks are assessed
